body:
## Changes

Complete the author workspace with real profile, novel and wallet data; reader ratings/reviews; novel and chapter comments with author management/replies; and the shared StoryCraft Light/Dark/System theme. Includes the author overview, profile and manuscript import screens.

## Validation

- Backend/frontend TypeScript checks passed.
- Latest verification: 49 backend tests and 12 frontend tests passed.
- Docker backend/web builds passed.
- Chrome checks covered author/reader/admin routes, comments, Light/Dark and mobile layouts.

## Follow-up

A separate branch will address draft/VIP access control, draft reliability, revision recovery and remaining author workflows identified during review.
